يمتنعوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَنِعُوا (yamtaniʕū) /jam.ta.ni.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# يُمْتَنَعُوا (yumtanaʕū) /jum.ta.na.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
